title: test_authority plants each secret word inside each token exception shape and asserts the secrets class holds
goal: Retrospective of SP-uzwbt63u: BG-xp3imb24's check listed which named texts stay secrets but not a secret word inside the span its new exception removes, so SECRET_TOKENS and PASSWORD_TOKENS fell to design and only the review caught it (BG-wuwypj42, S1). test_authority gains one test that, for each secrets word (secret, password, passphrase, credential, api, bearer, ssh) and each token exception shape bl_authority.without_token_counts removes (an upper-case NAME_TOKENS identifier, a phase or closed token, a model's token count), asserts class_reasons still returns secrets, so a later exception that removes a secret word fails the suite
